book.title: The Art of Strategy
book.author: Avinash K. Dixit and Barry J. Nalebuff

predict.question: B meets X 80% of the time; nets are 8 against X and −2 against Y. What is B’s expected net payoff?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The Art of Strategy analyzes choices whose payoffs depend on other people’s choices.
modelBoundary: A pays {A}; B pays {B}. The response itself is unchanged; the rival’s probability of choosing X rises from 50% to 80%. The rival mix is prescribed; no equilibrium, commitment or strategic adaptation is computed.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
